long long solve(long long n, int step) {
    long long a[16];
    a[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 16; ++i)

        long long option1 = (s + 1LL) + solve(a[s] - r, s - 1);
        long long option2 = solve(r, s - 1);
        ans += min(option1, option2);
    }
    return ans;
}

    cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n, 15);
